decision: V1 multi-agent tools (gpt-5.5, gpt-5.6-luna) are deferred: the model calls tool_search first. Namespace multi_agent_v1 has spawn_agent(message|items, fork_context, model, reasoning_effort), wait_agent(targets, timeout_ms), send_input(target, message|items, interrupt), resume_agent(id), close_agent(target). A child cannot spawn. Six open agents is the limit and a closed agent frees a slot. A finished child posts a <subagent_notification> user message to the parent

decision: Fan-out is capped by the Codex version: V1 allows 6 open agents (agents.max_threads, closed agents free a slot, children cannot spawn at the default depth of 1); V2 allows max_concurrent_threads_per_session 4 including the root, so 3 running children by default, with idle finished agents unloaded automatically and a limit error only when every slot is busy
why: Phase 3 requires Codex facts from real runs or official source. pstack fans out 2 to 6 agents in arena, architect, interrogate, how, why and swarm, so the skills must spawn in waves and handle the limit error

result: recorded

decision: spawn_agent tells the model to omit model unless an override is needed (V1) or unless the user explicitly asks (V2), and to pick overrides from the <model_catalog> or the Available model overrides list. pstack therefore defaults every role to inherit-parent, and a models block that /setup-pstack writes into $CODEX_HOME/AGENTS.md is the user's explicit request for those overrides
why: Phase 3 requires Codex facts from real runs or official source. The Cursor defaults name two model slugs, which would contradict Codex's own tool guidance on an account that has not chosen them
evidence: source rust-v0.162.1: multi_agents_spec.rs SPAWN_AGENT_INHERITED_MODEL_GUIDANCE, SPAWN_AGENT_INHERITED_MODEL_GUIDANCE_V2, SPAWN_AGENT_MODEL_CATALOG_GUIDANCE; spawn_agent also takes an optional agent_type that only names roles from the user's config, and plugin manifests cannot ship roles (manifest paths: skills, mcpServers, apps, hooks)
result: recorded

decision: Goals are Codex's loop: create_goal(objective, token_budget) may only be called when the user or developer instructions ask for it, keeps the thread running automatic continuation turns, and ends with update_goal status complete, blocked (same blocker three turns running) or paused (user request only). There is no timer, so waiting between ticks uses sleep or an exec_command that is polled

decision: fact-rollout-shape

decision: verify-codex
why: A residue check proves wording, not behavior. The Codex port needs a check that loads the plugin into a real Codex and reads what the model and the user would see
evidence: node .agents/skills/sync-pstack/scripts/verify-codex/verify-codex.mjs --repo . (codex-cli 0.162.1, mock Responses API, throwaway CODEX_HOME/HOME/workspace; --verbose prints the evidence of each check)
result: 19/19 checks passed. Static: plugin.json name and -codex version, marketplace entry, skill names, opt-in sidecars. Real Codex: marketplace add, plugin add at the manifest version, shipped scripts, catalog lists exactly the visible pstack skills plus the project-local sync-pstack, models block reaches the first user message, $pstack:poteto-mode and $pstack:poteto-help inject the skill body with its path, bare $poteto-mode injects nothing, a sibling skill reads through ../how/SKILL.md, the sandbox lets a skill write .pstack/ and refuses .agents/, spawn_agent applies model gpt-5.6-luna and reasoning_effort low to the child, the child sees the models block, the parent receives the child report

decision: verify-codex-mutation
why: A check that passes on the first run may be vacuous, so each repo-dependent check was run against a deliberately broken copy

result: drop poteto-help agents/openai.yaml -> sidecar check and catalog check FAIL (17/19). rename skills/how -> how2 -> name check and sibling-read check FAIL (17/19). version 0.15.34 without -codex -> version check FAIL (18/19). delete check-plan.mjs -> shipped-files check FAIL (18/19). marketplace path ./nope -> manifest and marketplace checks FAIL and the script stops cleanly (0/2, exit 1). decision: fact-tool-output-cap
why: The DSH sync adds a reload note because DSH prunes big tool results. The Codex rules add none, so the matching Codex behavior was measured
evidence: lab run on gpt-5.5: exec_command cat of generated files of 20,000, 40,000 and 60,000 characters (/tmp/p3/probe16.mjs); wc -c codex/skills/*/SKILL.md
result: 20,000 chars (4,800 tokens) and 40,000 chars (9,600 tokens) came through whole. 60,000 chars (14,400 tokens) was cut in the middle with 'Warning: truncated output (original token count: 14400)' and '…4400 tokens truncated…'. The largest pstack file is poteto-mode/SKILL.md at 21,676 bytes and the largest playbook is orchestrate.md at 17,345 bytes, so reading any of them whole survives. The catalog also tells the model to continue a truncated read to EOF.
